summary: The psalm’s widened step and steady ankles make the movement concrete. An unreliable support can also cause the one leaning on it to stagger.

senses.definition: David says his ankles did not give way when Yahweh widened the path under him. The unreliable person is compared to an unstable foot.
The psalm asks that the enemies’ loins continually shake. Ezekiel likens Egypt to a reed that gives way under the weight of people leaning on it.

note: Some indexed forms instead belong to עמד “stand,” as in Numbers 3:6. The narrative function of the names Maadai and Maadiah is clear, although their derivation from the slipping verb is uncertain.
